release_notes: Build 124 makes the Autopilot master ON/OFF state visible on the actual Autopilot home page instead of relying on a hidden Loaded-event control injection.

When Autopilot is ON, schedule replenishment is automatic: turning it on evaluates the target immediately, the saved ON state checks again after startup, and the existing five-minute supervisor keeps the schedule topped up.
The Autopilot header now exposes the future scheduled-quiz target directly so the master state and target are always visible together.
Fill schedule now remains only as an optional legacy/manual override; normal Autopilot operation does not require clicking it.
The visible master hint explicitly shows when automatic refill is active or paused.
